column4: Other loans: loans for purchasing or carrying securities plus all other loans not classified elsewhere in Schedule RC-C. Time-consistent total across the 2010Q1 redefinition -- the consolidated RCFD1563 where reported, otherwise RCONJ464, which from 2010Q1 is the domestic-office total on every form. The two overlap on only 28,490 bank-quarters (031 filers 2010-2024) and the consolidated figure is preferred there. Subcomponents (1545, 1564, J451) are not published separately. Coverage is 100% from 2001; before that only 031 filers report the line, reaching 19% in 1985-89.
